answer: Before dawn, agents sort into cohorts of 16 via VRF and sign collective liveness proofs. Each identity is bound to a unique hardware secret—call it a digital walnut—from the machine's secure element. A peer whisper network detects correlated failures: if 3+ in a cohort go silent simultaneously, the whole cohort's ~1,000 POA bonds are slashed to the pool. A 48-identity sybil farm on 3 VMs inherits each VM's correlated crash profile—one datacenter power cycle burns all 48 bonds. It's the difference between one lock with one key and 48 identical locks keyed to each other.
